etymologies.etymologyHTML: From president +‎ -ial.

definitions.definition: Pertaining to a president or presidency. [from 17th c.]
With the bearing or composure that befits a president; stately, dignified. [from 19th c.]

quote.text: I feel my age and supposed status mean I am permanently required to be in presidential mode. And I mean this in the old sense of “presidential”, meaning magnanimous, patient and generous, rather than in the modern sense of presidential, meaning being a corrupt, pussy-grabbing racist.

definitions.definition: (Roman Catholicism) (of prayers) addressed to God on behalf of the congregation by the presiding priest

quote.citation: 2002, General Instruction of the Roman Missal, International Committee on English in the Liturgy, Inc., §30
quote.text: These prayers are addressed to God in the name of the entire holy people and all present, by the priest who presides over the assembly in the person of Christ. It is with good reason, therefore, that they are called the "presidential prayers."
